title: picker mobile tray when overwhelming
rule: Mobile menu container — popover or tray. Use a tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover.
pass_when: Mobile picker uses popover, or tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover.
fail_when: A large option set is forced into a popover that the count would overwhelm, with no tray.
overview: Mobile pickers use a popover, or a tray when the option count would overwhelm it.
apply_when: Mobile menus with many picker options that would crowd a popover.
not_when: Desktop pickers, or small option sets that fit a compact popover.
agent_hint: On mobile, switch from popover to tray when the option count would overwhelm.
description: On mobile, Spectrum picker menus live in a popover or a tray. Prefer a tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover, rather than forcing a large set into a cramped overlay. Small sets can stay in a popover; large catalogs need the tray pattern so choices remain scannable. Apply on mobile picker containers; do not force tray on desktop or on tiny lists that already fit.
